captions.detailed: A compact, palm-sized camcorder in a uniform matte black finish. It features a main rectangular body with rounded corners, a cylindrical handgrip on one side, and a short, stepped lens barrel extending from the front. A rectangular flip-out side monitor is mounted on a hinge on the opposite side, and three small, rectangular control buttons are arranged vertically on the front face below the lens.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a handheld camcorder with a rounded main body, a side-mounted cylindrical handgrip, a front lens barrel, and a flip-out side monitor. The monitor should rotate outward on a vertical hinge, the lens ring should rotate continuously around its axis, and three small rectangular buttons on the front should depress independently.
captions.factory: The model is constructed as an assembly. First, the main body is created from a rounded Box primitive. The side handgrip is modeled using a Cylinder. The lens assembly is built from nested Cylinder primitives representing the barrel and outer ring. A rectangular Box is used for the side monitor, which is positioned on a vertical hinge offset. Finally, three small Box primitives are created for the front buttons, and all components are assembled with appropriate revolute, continuous, and prismatic joints.
